_about: UGRC-specific palette tokens that have no equivalent in CARTO Voyager's published style -
hillshade grades, road-class tans, rail/trail/transit, park/water/boundary variants. These
are layered on top of the tokens fetched live from Voyager's own style.json at build time
(see src/ugrc_styles/palette.py) to form the final palette.
Discipline: nothing here may duplicate an actual Voyager style value - if a token's color
legitimately comes from Voyager (matches a real layer's paint color, or clear intent, e.g.
hillshade's base tone = the land fill), it belongs in palette.py's CARTO_KEY_MAP instead.
Only genuinely UGRC-original tokens with no Voyager equivalent belong here.
'shield_text_interstate'/'shield_text_highway' are the one exception to 'no Voyager
equivalent': they're not from Voyager at all, but copied verbatim from UGRC's own
Vector_Overlay style (whose sprite sol's LiteLabels/LiteBase icons already borrow - see
theme.json) so each shield's route-number text keeps reading the way Vector_Overlay
designed it to against that same shield graphic.
